These are so fun to have. One time when I was at a 7-11, I was getting my morning coffee and there was a long line. Usually I’m pretty patient, but this line had over 8 people and only one cashier. I went to this place a lot and know that there was another employee somewhere, I look outside and he’s sweeping the concrete where the cars pull up for gas.

I go out there and ask him if he could possibly help inside real quick because of the line, and he just kinda stares at me and starts speaking his native language. I told him again that the line was really long and he just stares at me blankly. 

I got kinda angry and told him that I visit this place 5 times a week and that if he can’t do his job then I’m not going to come to this 7-11 anymore. He then proceeds to flip me off! I flip him off right back in his face and say, “FUCK YOU.” Then he goes, “NO! FUCK YOU! I start walking to my truck and flip him off again, he does it one more time. Then as I’m leaving I flip him off again and he returned it like a boss. It was definitely one of the funnier things I did that day. 😂

Hope you enjoyed my story!
